title: Report lost property
summary: Use the Community Portal to create an online report if you have lost property, provided the loss did not occur outside of NSW.

who_can_apply: When you require a NSW Police Force Event number for insurance purposes
After you have cancelled any lost credit or debit card
Where the description or identifying features of the property may increase the possibility of its return, should it be located or handed to police.
what_you_need: Your personal details or the personal details of the property owner (if applicable)
Details of how the property was lost
When the lost property was last seen and when it was discovered missing

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose property outside of NSW?
faqs.a: If you report property lost outside NSW using the NSW Police Force Community Portal, you must also report the loss to the Police Force in the state or territory where the item was lost.

faqs.q: What should I do if the loss is an emergency?
faqs.a: If the incident is an emergency or occurring now, call Triple Zero (000) immediately.

faqs.q: Who can report lost property online?
faqs.a: Anyone can report lost property online, even if you live interstate or overseas or are reporting on behalf of a business.
